source.title: A Blade for the Innocent: Into the War-Torn Hutuo Region of Where Winds Meet on XBOX
source.evidenceText: Eric Head of Where Winds Meet Publishing November 6, 2026 · 5 min read SummaryWhere Winds Meet’s Hutuo anniversary update arrives on XBOX Series X|S on November 13 (PT), bringing a new war-torn campaign centered on the Battle of Zhongdu Bridge.Players can face new bosses, try Horse Racing Chess and Jianghu Tactics, and wield the Dual Spears martial art.Anniversary events offer more than $150 worth of gifts, including a free Outfit Set of your choice and 42 Lingering Melody draws and 27 Resonating Melody draws. As our anniversary theme region, Hutuo, prepares to go live on XBOX Series X|S, we couldn’t be more excited to give you a glimpse of what’s to come. On November 13, wanderers across the XBOX community will step into this active, mud-and-steel warzone, navigating the devastating fallout of a sixteen-year conflict and throwing themselves into the desperate frontline defense at the battle of Zhongdu Bridge. In Hutuo, the relentless advance of invading northern forces is set to turn the riverbanks into a brutal proving ground. Amid the chaos, we wanted to confront players with the hardest question in Wuxia: what keeps your blade raised when empires crumble and the powers above fail? Righteousness and Conviction: Rethinking The True Essence of ‘Xia’ In Where Winds Meet, Hutuo delves deeply into the Eastern philosophy of ‘Xia’: a moral compass governed not by blind obedience to authority, but by an individual’s duty to protect the innocent and uphold justice when institutions fracture. At Zhongdu Bridge, loyalty to a crumbling throne and righteousness toward the people pull in opposite directions. The core of this story is not about glorifying the clash of armies, but honoring the courage of ordinary folk and sworn companions who choose to stand as a living shield before an unstoppable force. To ground that philosophy, the frontier is filled with intimate side quests showing the war from varied, ground-level perspectives. You will encounter conflicted soldiers choosing conscience over cruel military orders, displaced families holding onto hope along the reed-lined rivers, and nameless villagers risking their lives to shelter refugees. Even in history’s bleakest chapters, true heroism emerges not from imperial mandates, but from the quiet resilience of everyday lives. Mastering the Frontline: Surviving Hutuo’s Toughest Encounters Warfare on the frontier demands a more aggressive, tactical approach to combat. If you are preparing to cross the river, mastering enemy stance dynamics is essential. Conquering the Fierce General, Xiao Han: Serving as the climax of the Hutuo River Campaign, Xiao Han is fortified by Blood-forged Super Armor. To counter his relentless assault, focus on high-impact parries, bait out his overextended thrusts, and execute stance-breaking counterstrikes to shatter his armor before committing to full damage rotations Taming Moonveil Knoll with Bingshen: This solitary wanderer relies on rapid gap-closers and sweeping area attacks born of lifelong regret. Maintaining spatial discipline and dodging into—rather than away from—his follow-up strikes will give you clean openings to punish his recoveries. Surviving Yelu Abuli’s Dark Rituals: Facing this mystic royal and shaman requires close arena awareness. Yelu Abuli manipulates ceremonial fire, forcing players to remain mobile, interrupt channeled incantations, and bait area hazards away from the center of the battlefield. Tactical Versatility: Yuen Woo-ping’s Dual Spears (Arriving Nov 26) To counter these escalating battlefield threats, legendary action director Yuen Woo-ping (“Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon”) led the motion capture and choreography for the upcoming Dual Spears martial art, arriving November 26. Designed around fluid transitions, the weapon system combines two complementary combat roles. By executing the Dual-Weapon Skill mid-combo, players seamlessly weave light thrusts (Sustained Firepower) into heavy downward strikes (Stance-Breaking Impact) without resetting attack frames, sustaining uninterrupted offensive pressure against armored targets like Xiao Han. Two Strategic Tabletop Breaks: Horse Racing Chess & Jianghu Tactics When you need respite from the siege lines, Hutuo introduces two rich, casual-yet-tactical board game modes playable across the Jianghu: Horse Racing Chess: Step directly onto the board as living game pieces. Roll dice, trigger familiar Mystic Skills, and race fellow players to the finish line in a lively competitive sprint. Jianghu Tactics: A deeper strategic mode that brings the game’s Heroic Spirit roster to a tactical board. Victory hinges on clever board positioning, gear allocation, and activating character bonds to build winning synergies round after round. Optimized for XBOX Series X|S Exploring Hutuo’s war-torn frontier is built for the XBOX living-room experience, with Smart Delivery, HDR support, AMD FSR 2 upscaling, and an updated interface with larger text. XBOX Series X delivers a 4K upscale from 1080p, while XBOX Series S delivers a 2K upscale from 900p. Memory optimizations help keep gameplay smooth. XBOX Game Pass Perks After the update on November 13, simply log in and take part in anniversary events to claim over $150 worth of gifts! Just for logging in, choose a free Outfit Set worth 2,580 Echo Beads, from 12 distinct style, and easily earn 42 Lingering Melody draws and 27 Resonating Melody draws through anniversary events! To welcome XBOX players to the Jianghu, XBOX Game Pass members could claim a launch Perks bundle featuring 450 Echo Jade, 90,000 Coins, 6 Attunement Stones, 30 Large Tuning Stones, 3 Pillow Pills, and 3 Lingering Melodies. The claim period ended January 7, 2027. There are even more ongoing anniversary perks coming to XGP – stay turn! Experience a story of unwavering conviction, camaraderie, and the true meaning of heroism, and claim the most generous rewards we’ve offered since launch, available on XBOX Series X|S on November (PT). Come celebrate

Learn moreOnline multiplayer on console requires XBOX Game Pass Essential, Premium, or Ultimate (subscriptions sold separately).DETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionBOMBANANA! Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode? - 3-Player Co-op: No more, no less. Exactly three monkeys required. - 3 Game Modes: - Campaign: 30 handcrafted levels with increasing difficulty. - Endless: Procedurally generated, wave-based levels that keep getting harder. - Custom: Players create their own challenge by adjusting bomb difficulty, the timer, module types, environmental hazards, and how many mistakes are allowed. - Asymmetric Roles: Every player sees, hears, and acts differently. - Fun interactions: Point, wave, gesture or flail wildly. Your options are only limited by your imagination and each player's Emote wheel. - Slapping: Obviously an essential feature. - New Environments: We all know the trusty minivan, but what about a plane? What other environments can you defuse bombs in? - Environmental Hazards: Navigate events like power outages, obstructions and loud interruptions. - Voice Chat: Some of you can talk, some of you can’t. You’ll figure it out. - Puzzle Modules: Each bomb has different modules and different rules, all of which are guaranteed to induce different kinds of panic. - Level System: Defuse the bomb to unlock new levels. The better you get, the harder they are. - Color Blind Mode: Just because the monkey is blind, doesn’t mean he can’t defuse a bomb! Colors used across objects and the UI have been adapted to support two different types of color blindness.
